# Figures

**Owner: Krishna.** Generated by `python -m src.report.figures`; do not edit by hand.

Every figure is built from a file in `benchmarks/raw/`. PNG at 300 dpi for slides, PDF (vector) for the paper.

| figure | caption and source |
|---|---|
| [`fig1_gap_ratio_distribution`](fig1_gap_ratio_distribution.png) | Realised over planned time on 26,369 OD legs; 98.3% exceed the plan, median 2.00×. Clipped at 8× for display. Source: w1_leg_summary.csv |
| [`fig2_corridor_audit`](fig2_corridor_audit.png) | Welch tests on log time ratios, Benjamini-Hochberg at 5%: 273 corridors significantly slower, 512 faster, of 1,130 with >=10 legs. Source: w2_corridor_audit.csv |
| [`fig3_top_bottlenecks`](fig3_top_bottlenecks.png) | The 15 highest excess ratios among corridors confirmed slower. Source: w2_top20_bottlenecks.csv |
| [`fig4_support_instability`](fig4_support_instability.png) | Top-20 bottleneck lists at a 10-leg and a 30-leg support floor share 0 corridors. Sources: w2_top20_bottlenecks.csv, w2_corridor_audit_support30.csv |
| [`fig5_model_mae`](fig5_model_mae.png) | Test-split MAE. The bar is the per-corridor median (33.04), not the mean, because MAE is minimised by the median. Sources: w7_model_metrics_v2_stepsize.csv, w7_model_metrics_v2.csv |
| [`fig6_mae_by_support`](fig6_mae_by_support.png) | Test MAE by how much history the corridor had. On unseen corridors 111.2 → 75.9 min; elsewhere the gain is 0.02-0.51 min. Source: w7_model_metrics_v2_stepsize.csv |
| [`fig7_threshold_sensitivity`](fig7_threshold_sensitivity.png) | Alerting across delay thresholds. The logistic classifier holds MCC 0.507-0.540 while the share of legs alerted falls 98% to 49%; the stream's own flag is weaker at every threshold. Source: w5_threshold_sensitivity.csv |
| [`fig8_scale_runtime`](fig8_scale_runtime.png) | network_baseline and corridor_aggregate imported unchanged; wall time includes each run's parquet scan. Source: w7_scale_benchmark.json |
| [`fig9_severity_precision`](fig9_severity_precision.png) | Notification precision by computed severity over the earliest 2,000 replayed legs, scored with the history each leg had at its own time; hollow markers are the first, leaked measurement (D-054). Sources: w8_replay_leakage.json, w6_exception_eval.json |
